scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")

local TARGET_PLACE_ID = 72742428103609
local allowedPlayerName = "Yo Username Here"

local function createGui(player)
	if player.Name ~= allowedPlayerName then
		return
	end

	-- Prevent duplicate GUI
	local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

	if playerGui:FindFirstChild("Vata909tt_IsBackGui") then
		playerGui.Vata909tt_IsBackGui:Destroy()
	end

	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "Vata909tt_IsBackGui"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.Parent = playerGui

	--==================================================
	-- MAIN FRAME
	--==================================================

	local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
	mainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
	mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 320)
	mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.3, 0)
	mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
	mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	mainFrame.Visible = false
	mainFrame.Parent = gui

	local mainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	mainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	mainCorner.Parent = mainFrame

	--==================================================
	-- TITLE BAR
	--==================================================

	local titleBar = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	titleBar.Name = "TitleBar"
	titleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
	titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
	titleBar.Text = "Vata909tt GUI"
	titleBar.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	titleBar.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	titleBar.TextSize = 16
	titleBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
	titleBar.Parent = mainFrame

	local titleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	titleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	titleCorner.Parent = titleBar

	--==================================================
	-- SCROLL FRAME
	--==================================================

	local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	scroll.Name = "ScrollFrame"
	scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -60)
	scroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 40)
	scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 6
	scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
	scroll.Parent = mainFrame

	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
	layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	layout.Parent = scroll

	--==================================================
	-- TOGGLE BUTTON
	--==================================================

	local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	toggleBtn.Name = "ToggleButton"
	toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 110, 0, 30)
	toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
	toggleBtn.Text = "Open GUI"
	toggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	toggleBtn.TextSize = 14
	toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
	toggleBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	toggleBtn.Parent = gui

	local toggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	toggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	toggleCorner.Parent = toggleBtn

	--==================================================
	-- DRAGGING
	--==================================================

	local dragging = false
	local dragInput
	local dragStart
	local startPos

	titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = mainFrame.Position

			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	titleBar.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			dragInput = input
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input == dragInput and dragging then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart

			local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if camera then
				local viewport = camera.ViewportSize

				local newX = math.clamp(
					startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
					0,
					math.max(0, viewport.X - mainFrame.AbsoluteSize.X)
				)

				local newY = math.clamp(
					startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y,
					0,
					math.max(0, viewport.Y - mainFrame.AbsoluteSize.Y)
				)

				mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
					startPos.X.Scale,
					newX,
					startPos.Y.Scale,
					newY
				)
			end
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- BUTTON CREATOR
	--==================================================

	local function addButton(text, callback)
		local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")

		btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
		btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
		btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		btn.TextSize = 14
		btn.Text = text
		btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
		btn.Parent = scroll

		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
		corner.Parent = btn

		btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			local success, err = pcall(callback)

			if not success then
				warn("GUI button error:", err)
			end
		end)

		return btn
	end

	--==================================================
	-- MAKE HINT
	--==================================================

	addButton("Make Hint", function()
		local hint = Instance.new("Hint")
		hint.Text = "THIS SERVER HAS BEEN HACKED BY VATA909TT!! DISC INVITE: https://discord.gg/sbTnFCrVj"
		hint.Parent = workspace

		Debris:AddItem(hint, 10)
	end)

	addButton("Relam", function()
		local playerList = Players:GetPlayers()

		if #playerList == 0 then
			return
		end

		local success, result = pcall(function()
			return TeleportService:TeleportAsync(TARGET_PLACE_ID, playerList)
		end)

		if not success then
			warn("Teleport failed:", result)
		end
	end)
	
	addButton("Make Message", function()
		local message = Instance.new("Message")
		message.Text = "THIS SERVER HAS BEEN HACKED BY VATA909TT!! DISC INVITE: https://discord.gg/sbTnFCrVj"
		message.Parent = workspace

		Debris:AddItem(message, 5)
	end)


	--==================================================
	-- FALLING HEADS
	--==================================================

	addButton("Spawn Falling Heads", function()
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then
			return
		end

		for i = 1, 10 do
			local head = Instance.new("Part")

			head.Size = Vector3.new(2, 1, 1)
			head.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			head.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 200)
			head.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			head.Name = "FallingHead"

			head.Position = camera.CFrame.Position + Vector3.new(
				math.random(-10, 10),
				math.random(20, 30),
				math.random(-10, 10)
			)

			head.Anchored = false
			head.CanCollide = true
			head.Parent = workspace

			local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
			decal.Texture = "rbxassetid://7075746925"
			decal.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
			decal.Parent = head

			Debris:AddItem(head, 10)
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- ADD DECALS
	--==================================================

	addButton("Add Decals", function()
		local decalTextureId = "rbxassetid://73859504735494"

		local faces = {
			Enum.NormalId.Front,
			Enum.NormalId.Back,
			Enum.NormalId.Left,
			Enum.NormalId.Right,
			Enum.NormalId.Top,
			Enum.NormalId.Bottom
		}

		for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then

				-- Skip characters/NPCs
				local parentModel = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")

				if not (
					parentModel
						and parentModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					) then

					-- Remove existing decals
					for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
						if child:IsA("Decal") then
							child:Destroy()
						end
					end

					-- Add decal to all six faces
					for _, face in ipairs(faces) do
						local decal = Instance.new("Decal")

						decal.Name = "VataDecal"
						decal.Texture = decalTextureId
						decal.Face = face
						decal.Transparency = 0

						decal.Parent = part
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- SKY
	--==================================================

	addButton("Sky", function()
		local skyTextureId = "rbxassetid://71869538800676"

		-- Remove old skies
		for _, obj in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
			if obj:IsA("Sky") then
				obj:Destroy()
			end
		end

		local sky = Instance.new("Sky")

		sky.Name = "VataSky"
		sky.SkyboxBk = skyTextureId
		sky.SkyboxDn = skyTextureId
		sky.SkyboxFt = skyTextureId
		sky.SkyboxLf = skyTextureId
		sky.SkyboxRt = skyTextureId
		sky.SkyboxUp = skyTextureId

		sky.Parent = Lighting
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- FLIP GRAVITY
	--==================================================

	addButton("Flip Gravity", function()
		if workspace.Gravity == 196.2 then
			workspace.Gravity = -196.2
		else
			workspace.Gravity = 196.2
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- RANDOM TELEPORT ALL
	--==================================================

	addButton("Random Teleport All", function()
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if p.Character then
				local root = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

				if root then
					root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
						math.random(-100, 100),
						math.random(10, 50),
						math.random(-100, 100)
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- EXPLOSIVE ORBS
	--==================================================

	addButton("Spawn Explosive Orbs", function()
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

		if not camera then
			return
		end

		for i = 1, 10 do
			local orb = Instance.new("Part")

			orb.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			orb.Size = Vector3.new(3, 3, 3)
			orb.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			orb.BrickColor = BrickColor.Random()
			orb.Anchored = false
			orb.CanCollide = false

			orb.Position = camera.CFrame.Position + Vector3.new(
				math.random(-15, 15),
				math.random(10, 20),
				math.random(-15, 15)
			)

			orb.Name = "ExplosiveOrb"
			orb.Parent = workspace

			local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")

			bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(
				math.random(-20, 20),
				math.random(10, 30),
				math.random(-20, 20)
			)

			bodyVelocity.P = 5000
			bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(
				10000,
				10000,
				10000
			)

			bodyVelocity.Parent = orb

			Debris:AddItem(orb, 10)
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- NIGHT VISION
	--==================================================

	local nightVisionEnabled = false

	addButton("Toggle Night Vision", function()
		local blur = Lighting:FindFirstChild("VataNightVisionBlur")
		local cc = Lighting:FindFirstChild("VataNightVisionColor")

		if nightVisionEnabled then

			if blur then
				blur.Enabled = false
			end

			if cc then
				cc.Enabled = false
			end

			nightVisionEnabled = false

		else

			if not blur then
				blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
				blur.Name = "VataNightVisionBlur"
				blur.Parent = Lighting
			end

			blur.Size = 3
			blur.Enabled = true

			if not cc then
				cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
				cc.Name = "VataNightVisionColor"
				cc.Parent = Lighting
			end

			cc.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
			cc.Brightness = 0.15
			cc.Contrast = 0.1
			cc.Enabled = true

			nightVisionEnabled = true
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- MUSIC
	--==================================================

	local musicPlaying = false
	local musicSound

	addButton("Toggle Music", function()
		if not musicSound then
			musicSound = Instance.new("Sound")

			musicSound.Name = "VataMusic"
			musicSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://1840712882"
			musicSound.Looped = true
			musicSound.Volume = 1
			musicSound.Parent = workspace

			local distortion1 = Instance.new("DistortionSoundEffect")
			distortion1.Level = 1
			distortion1.Parent = musicSound
		end

		if musicPlaying then
			musicSound:Stop()
			musicPlaying = false
		else
			musicSound:Play()
			musicPlaying = true
		end
	end)
	
	addButton("Anonymus", function()
		-- Looping Anonymous Sound (Começa aos 9 segundos + Distorção)
		local Spooky1 = Instance.new("Sound")
		Spooky1.Parent = workspace
		Spooky1.Name = "Anonymousshii"

        TextChatService.TextChannels.RBXGeneral:SendAsync(msg)

end

local tmxMessages = {
    "CLAN ON TOP 🔥", "FYTER BNEGA? 🤣", "MEH FIRE 🔥",

    "MEH DRAGON", "PHOENIX", "WOLF",
    "MEH TIGER", "LION", "EAGLE",
    "MEH SHARK", "GHOST", "MASTER"
}

local function generateLine()
    if pattern == "" then pattern = "_" end
    local result = ""
    while #result < 150 do
        result = result .. pattern
    end
    return string.sub(result, 1, 150)
end

local function startTMXSpam()
    if saying then return end
    saying = true
    sendChatMessage(targetName .. " SPAMMER STARTED 👑")
    task.wait(0.1)

    spamThread = task.spawn(function()
        while saying do
            local randomMsg = tmxMessages[math.random(1, #tmxMessages)]
            local msg = generateLine().."\n"..targetName.." "..randomMsg
            sendChatMessage(msg)
            task.wait(math.max(delayTime, 0.2))

end

local function stopAll()
    saying = false
    if spamThread then
        task.cancel(spamThread)
        spamThread = nil
    end
    sendChatMessage("SPAMMER STOPPED 🛑")
end

if not success then
    gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

-- ===== MAIN FRAME =====

local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", mainFrame)
layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center

local function createInput(placeholder, text, order)
    local container = Instance.new("Frame", mainFrame)
    container.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 35)
    container.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 20, 20)
    container.LayoutOrder = order
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner", container)
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", container)
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 10, 10)
    stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    local input = Instance.new("TextBox", container)
    input.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0)
    input.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
    input.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    input.Text = text
    input.PlaceholderText = placeholder
    input.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    input.TextSize = 14
    input.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
    input.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120)
    input.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    container.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 0, 0)}):Play()
    end)
    container.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 10, 10)}):Play()
    end)
    return input
end

local function createButton(text, color, order)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", mainFrame)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 40)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = color
    btn.Text = text
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.TextSize = 15
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.LayoutOrder = order
    btn.AutoButtonColor = false
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner", btn)
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local darkenColor = Color3.new(color.R * 0.7, color.G * 0.7, color.B * 0.7)
    local lightenColor = Color3.new(math.min(color.R * 1.2, 1), math.min(color.G * 1.2, 1), math.min(color.B * 1.2, 1))
    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = lightenColor}):Play()
    end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = color}):Play()
    end)
    btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {BackgroundColor3 = darkenColor}):Play()
    end)
    btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {BackgroundColor3 = lightenColor}):Play()
    end)
    return btn
end

local titleSpacer = Instance.new("Frame", mainFrame)

titleSpacer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
titleSpacer.LayoutOrder = 0

local targetInput = createInput("Target Name (e.g. Ayush)", "", 1)
local delayInput = createInput("Delay (seconds)", tostring(delayTime), 2)

local startBtn = createButton("START SPAM", Color3.fromRGB(120, 10, 10), 4)
local stopBtn = createButton("STOP", Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40), 5)

-- ===== TOGGLE BUTTON =====
local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", gui)
toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 65, 0, 50)
toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -25)
toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 12, 12)
toggleBtn.Text = "WOLF V4"
toggleBtn.TextSize = 13
toggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 20, 20)
toggleBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
toggleBtn.Visible = true
toggleBtn.Draggable = true

local toggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", toggleBtn)
toggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
local toggleStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", toggleBtn)
toggleStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 0)
toggleStroke.Thickness = 2

-- ===== INPUT HANDLING =====
targetInput:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
    local text = targetInput.Text
    if text ~= "" then
        targetName = "[" .. text .. "]"
    else
        targetName = "[TARGET]"
    end
end)

delayInput:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
    local num = tonumber(delayInput.Text)
    if num and num > 0 then
        delayTime = num
    else
        delayInput.Text = tostring(delayTime)
    end
end)

patternInput:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
    if patternInput.Text ~= "" then
        pattern = patternInput.Text
    end
end)

startBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(startTMXSpam)
stopBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(stopAll)

local menuOpen = true
toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    menuOpen = not menuOpen
    if menuOpen then
        mainFrame.Visible = true
        TweenService:Create(mainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 290)}):Play()
    else
        local closeTween = TweenService:Create(mainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)})
        closeTween:Play()
        closeTween.Completed:Wait()
        mainFrame.Visible = false
    end
end)
